title: gavilea platyantha
intro: Gavilea platyantha, commonly known as the New Zealand gavilea or mountain orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gavilea platyantha include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and an antispasmodic, making it useful for relieving coughs and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
